<thought>We need to determine how many methyl (CH₃) groups are present in the unknown sample. The most direct way is to obtain the ¹H NMR spectrum, which will show signals for methyl protons (typically around 0.8–1.2 ppm). By counting distinct methyl signals we can infer the number of methyl groups. We'll request the proton NMR spectrum for the sample.</thought>
